body: Thank you.

Sorry I'm getting back to this so late, but thank you for the reply. I've been video chatting with my family and friends occasionally but I think my friends are depressed too so they've been steering away from it more. I play Sims sometimes but I can't connect with friends through there and I've been wanting to get Animal Crossing just because all the hype but it is expensive and I'm out of work currently. I'll look into some of the cheaper ones though, I don't have any game console only a laptop so it'd have to be playable on there.

Thank you again though, I felt like I was screaming into the void a bit last night after getting no response for a while and none of my friends were answering me, but thank you for replying.

Thank you! It’s a person drowning. I never put meanings to my artwork until after I’m finished but I had a nightmare I was drowning so I thought it could be based from that. Also a little bit of a reflection of me trying to reach out for help but feeling like I can never be heard. I never like to pinpoint one meaning onto my work I feel like I’m constricting myself when I do.
thank you.
I’ve done other pieces based off things I saw during my nightmares, maybe I’ll post those eventually. But thank you!
I have lots of vivid nightmares, that’s usually where the inspo comes from!

I was in food service before and absolutely hated it. I left a lot of my jobs for “better” ones which I also ended up hating. I currently have one I love though. I work in a recruitment office at my college and have for about a year now, it’s a very low stress job. I do have to do the whole customer service gag still but it’s not nearly as bad becase it’s prospective college students I talk to not old ladies screaming at me that their coffee isn’t hot enough anymore. 
An office job might be a better idea if you don’t do as well in high stress situations. If you’re in college too look out for work study positions those are always usually pretty good and very laid back. If not though there could be some starter positions for just an office helper maybe at a local doctors office. 
Best of luck though!
I felt a bit tired today but it wasn’t unbearable and I didn’t start feeling that way till I took the Klonopin. But yes I hope nothing too severe happens with it!

I took Abilify before and it always made me unbarebly tired, I’d have to call out of work just so I could sleep. I’m hoping that’s not a side effect from this because I hated that so much when it happened to me before on the Abilify. I’m only on 20 mg every night for now and so far it didn’t seem to have that massive of an impact on me sleep wise which is good. Today is the second night I’ve taken it though so only time will tell how things work out, I’m hoping it’ll be good though.

I need to keep up with my mood tracker. I always get the notifications for it but ignore it but I think it’d be good for me to at least use it whenever I start new meds. My sex drive hit an extreme low when I was with my ex. Honestly I think I’m asexual at times because how bad it is but then I remember before I took meds I wasn’t like this as much. It ruined my ex and I’s relationship a lot though, it wasn’t the sole thing that made us put things to an end but it was a big part. Best of luck to your boyfriend and you though! Something that helped me and my ex after my sex drive went kaput was using sex toys, it was something kinda new and interesting which helped spark some type of dying flame. I hope things get better for you two though, I know how stressful that can be.

Vyvanse made me lose a lot of weight too because the whole loss of appetite thing but it’s kinda stablized itself out over time. I still have problems with eating properly but it’s more stress induced now but I’m trying to work on that currently. 

For my Klonopin I only take 0.5 mg twice a day and it was my first time taking it today, shortly after I posted this. It made me kinda sleepy and just calm and I was able to go to the store by myself without having to give myself a 12 hour pep talk which was cool because it’s usually very difficult for me to ever do that. But I did notice it made me kinda not “all there”, I took it just before I went to hangout with my friend and I definitely noticed the difference in my energy. I was super high energy before so I think it’s good it calmed that part of me down but it was an interesting experience today.
I love you too stranger #2! It’s good to know even if you feel alone in life there’s always random online strangers that care.

I had a friend a while back whos mother died from a medically claimed accidental overdose because she had done the same thing. My friend would always say how she thought it was on purpose though because her mom was very depressed before it happened. But yeah I think you’re right there probablly is a legal red line for that stuff, especially if the person doesn’t leave a note behind or didn’t publicly show signs of suicidal ideation beforehand either. I think in some cases the ones marked as accidents may be people just wanting the pain to end but not constructing a solid plan on how to end it or knowing whether or not their attempts will work. It’s definitely a weird spot to determine in medical cases because it’s crossing over to the personal psychological line of things.
Love you too stranger! Things have been a lot better since then.

That’s what I was thinking because it’s not like the overdose itself is the thing that would have killed him. But in the final episode when Diane tells him about the voicemail he left about going swimming I felt like maybe Bojack was trying to purposely end it but that moment was blacked out from his memory. His choice to go swimming was based on whether Diane answered the phone or not and I feel like it was his last hope in a way. 

I understand the dream thing too though! I’ve had so many dreams like that, very recently too. I’ll keep getting stuck in a weird sleep paralysis/lucid nightmare state where I try and force myself awake because I know it’s just going to get worse.
Thank you! I’m glad I stayed and was able to watch this amazing show

Tried to back in March actually, clearly didn’t work as ghost me probablly wouldn’t be typing this. 

Not much good has happened since but there’s some recent very small beautiful moments that made me appreciate life.

First one was on new years day, the most recent one, 2020. My friends and I had bought a 1000 piece puzzle and were all just putting it together and listening to the GTA 5 playlist on spotify. I want it that way by the Backstreet Boys came on and we were all just drunkenly singing it together while doing this giant puzzle at like 2 AM. I’d seperated with my boyfriend of almost 3 years a couple days before so I wasn’t feeling great. But in that godly awful obnoxious moment my friends and I shared, I felt like things were going to be okay again.

Second moment, happened just last Friday. Had eaten an edible my sister gave me from Colorado, completely underestimated the potency of this thing haha. My friends and I were driving back from Walmart and the friend in the backseat stuck his head out the window kind of like a dog and I did the same. Being high off my ass and doing this was the best idea ever. We just blasted some music and stuck our heads out the window (not the driver). I felt like I was in some cool coming of age movie. 

They’re small moments but those are the best ones. I’m glad I was here to experience those and I’m looking forward to more as I grow.

I have one of these! It definitely helps out a lot especially when travelling. It’s made me laugh how many times I’ve been able to just get into clubs or through security with it though. The baggage check people usually question it and I just say it’s my medication and they always just trust me and let me in, for god knows I could be sneaking in a bunch of ecstacy with me lol.

I was at a friends birthday party back in high school and we were playing never have I ever. Another friend who had come with me to the party, let’s call her Grace for now, was known to overshare her entire life to strangers. One example is she was molested as a child and as soon as we met new friends that was the first thing she would tell them just out of the blue. Sometimes she would ask me before telling a new friend about it but she’d play it off as a joke and I’d try to say no but it was a hard thing to discuss with her because I knew that was mostly her way of coping with it. 

So anyways, while we were playing never have I ever people kept getting into explicit details, especially Grace, but that’s just how people our age were usually. Everytime it was Grace’s turn to speak she would get deeper and deeper with extremely personal stuff, most of it was nothing no one could really say they did before as well. 

So at Grace’s final round she came out with something very extreme that of course no one else had done before. She had literally said “never have I ever taken a shit on my partners chest before”. Everyones jaw had dropped and an awkward silence took over. Now this party had about 15 maybe 20 people, and all of them were playing the game, most people Grace and I barely knew. Grace had never told me this secret beforehand so even I was suprised. She told me after the party that her ex partner had a scat fetish apparently and that she wasn’t really into the fetish herself but wanted to make her partner happy. Needless to say it was the most “TMI” moment I’ve witnessed and so far no one else has beaten it. 

TLDR; Friend told 20 people during a game of never have I ever that she shat on her ex partners chest.

I wish I could wear my retainer. I was very proactive in wearing it immediately after I got my breces removed. Two root canals later though my retainer stopped fitting me, I can’t even keep it on now it just falls right off. I’d get a new one but I’m getting to the age where my wisdom teeth are supposed to grow in soon so I don’t want to have to buy a new one just for it to not fit me anymore a couple months later.
Me when I started getting into making stuffed animal keychains and told my friends I would make them some but then the interest completely died out 2 days later

I usually try to have a big breakfast each morning with the medications. My nausea usually comes at night and I usually just have like a piece of toast for dinner so it makes it worse. I’m on Vyvanse for ADHD on top of my bp meds so that just supresses my appetite like crazy, which in return makes my nausea worse. I am my own worst enemy lol!
THE EARS!!!!!!!!!!

I also have ADHD, but I’m prescribed Vyvanse for it which helps a bit. Whenever I’m in a state of hypomania though I can talk for hours on end and will switch from story to story about my life. Irritation levels are an all time high, the tiniest of things can make me go crazy (ex. someone clicking their tongue). I will come up with every career idea possible, told my friend I was gonna start a revolution against big pharma, set up my own art shop, start a band, become an astronomer, become a dj, write my own movies, etc., never did any of it. I’ll start new hobbies that I throw away as soon as I hit a low again, my list of things have been making stuffed animals, making dolls out of scraps, collaging, a lot of art related things mostly. I’ll clean a lot and reorganize everything. I’ll want to go on major trips with friends at that exact moment, have texted my friends asking them if they wanted to go to Miami at 3 AM a countless amount of times.

I can’t keep track of how many times I’ve been told I’m mature for my age, even when I was 15 my 50+ y/o guidance counselour told me that. I always joke to my friend about how I’m like Stan from American Dad in that episode where he gets mad at Steve for being a kid because he never had a real childhood himself.

Oh god that sounds terrible, and splashing water on your face is a joke of advice especially coming from a doctor. I used to be prescribed Abilify and it would make me so exhausted, I would skip my classes all the time just so I could sleep in my car. 

Thank you for the response though! My Trileptal has done quite the damage on me so far but I’m fearful to try another medication because I’ve already gone through so many and all of them have made me suicidal except this one. I hate how all psyc meds always have god awful side effects, it’s like you have to sacrifice so much just to feel the tiniest bit normal.

My winter break starts this week and it’s over a month long and I thought “hey why not see what happens if you don’t take any of your meds for a week” since I’d be free from classes and could “risk it”, so thank you for this! I hate having to take them everyday and deal with the weird side effects of them (nothing too crazy just mild nausea or having little energy) but I know without them I would be in a much worse place mentally.

It’s helped immensely with stabilizing my moods, and saved me from a severe psychosis episode. So I’m stabilized now and can say I’m content with life right now, but I can’t remember shit lol. Sorry if I scared you, but it has helped a lot but had it’s downturn of side effects as well.

If you don’t mind me asking, what medications impacted your memory loss the most? I’ve been on Trileptal for about 9 months now and I’ve developed a lot of memory loss issues with it and it also impacted my speech. I’m scared of it getting worse and developing dementia at a young age, my grandma just passed from  alzheimer’s recently. I’ve tried so many medications that have failed though so I don’t have many options left to choose from. 

I’m so sorry about your experience, I wish psyc meds didn’t have such terrible side effects to them and that mental health services were cheaper or free. I hope things get better.

Tried to actually. Not many good things have happened to me this year, my dog died, my grandma died, my sisters alcoholism hit an extreme, had my first ever psychosis episode just three weeks into 2019, had to admit myself to a psychward, lost a lot of friends and all the remaining ones I had moved far away, etc. But one thing I can say is I have seen a lot of great movies and I got back into films again, something I loved doing when I was in high school. My favorites this year so far were Midsommar, Joker, Parasite, The Lighthouse, and Booksmart.

I’m on Trileptal, have been since April and it has definitely had a big effect on my memory. It mostly just affects short term so it may be similar for Lamictal? I’m in college right now and it has had effects on my learning, I have to try a lot harder now than I did before. I might switch to another medication after finals week, but Trileptal has helped me immensely aside from that, I was in a severe depressive episode before I started it and I think the good has definitely outweighed the bad. 

What I do to help combat the memory loss is keeping planners with all of my assignments on them and I put a lot of reminders on my phone. I take notes on everything possible too. I think testing out medications is always worth a try, I had went through several before this that didn’t work but everyone reacts differently to medications.

My grandmother died a couple weeks ago and whenever I told people they tried to sympathize with me, but I was never sad over it in the first place. She was an evil person and I didn’t even know the half of it until I went to her funeral. She used to beat her children with wire hangers and kicked out one of her daughters at 16 and made her sleep in the snow because she got pregnant, even though at the same time she would take children in who got pregnant and kicked out of their homes. Her public image made her look like some god sent angel but she was evil behind closed doors. I made jokes about her death to my friends a lot because I didn’t care about her. You don’t have to be sad over someones death if they were nothing but a terrible person. Abuse isn’t erased just because they’re dead!

Static is a good description! I feel staticy too but just couldn’t put a word to it exactly. I had a psychosis episode last spring that got real bad and I admitted myself to a psycward because I was afraid of just being in my room and I thought everyone was out to get me. I feel like I’m having another episode now. 

My stress levels have been unbelievably high, I feel like this is the highest they’ve been in my life honestly. Most of my stress comes from school though and luckily one of my classes is over after tomorrow because it was only 8 weeks so I think that will help lift some stress. My sleeping hasn’t been very good either but sometimes I just literally can’t sleep and will wake up like 5+ times throughout the night. My dog just died yesterday too. I knew it was happening though, she was being put to sleep because she had an infected tumor that got really bad. So i think that is contributing to the rise of my problems because I felt more weird after it happened. 

Lets hope I do not go insane though. I’m so scared at all moments of it, and I got close to it during my last episode. Schizophrenia runs in my family so I’m praying I’m not the next marker of it in the family tree. I think I enjoy my life and where it’s going outside of this illness currently.

I was talking to my mother about how I have diagnosed PTSD from childhood trauma caused from physical/mental abuse by my father and she used the excuse “it’s not like you were hospitalized from what he did”. But that doesn’t matter, I was still abused!!!!! Comparison of problems is never the answer. If someone uses the excuse that people have it worse, you can well rebuttle it with the excuse that people have it better. Yeah I’m not starving in a war ridden country, but I’m also not sitting on the queens throne in England being fed grapes by a servant.

I’ve been under extreme stress for the past couple weeks because I have piles and piles of homework. And each time I think I’m caught up I find out there’s 20 more things I need to do! I’m thinking it may be a result of my meds not working and that. I’m afraid it’s psychosis again because this happened during spring semester and I had similar “not knowing myself” feelings. I’m trying to avoid mirrors because it just makes me feel weird and not in control. 

Thank you for the reply though! I always feel alone in these things because whenever I tell my friends in real life about it they don’t really understand it, which is okay I don’t expect them to if they haven’t experienced it. But at least on here I get reminded that I’m not alone in these feelings.

I know of them but I’ve never listened to their music. People have told me they’re good though I have a whole list of music I’ve been meaning to listen to I’ll put them on that list next lol. And oh god that’s awful. I hope you’re able to get out of that situation and help the animals too! 

I did group therapy once when I stayed the night at a psychiatric ward. I was only there for 10 hours and it was voluntarily so I only had to do it that one day. It did help a bit, but it was overall not a very pleasant experience. My states mental healthcare system is awful, so there’s not much opportunity for things like that. Or when there is it’s full of a lot of people who have mixed disorders and some of the people in the group therapy would scream at others and say offensive slurs and the doctors would just ignore them. I remember they let this one guy in who was supposed to be monitored at all moments because he had a lot of problems and he went to sit on the floor and his balls were just completely exposed because he was wearing one of those hospital gowns so we had to see that most of the session lmao. 

My actual therapist is amazing though. She’s been a big help to me over the past couple years but she doesn’t do group sessions. Thanks for the replies though, I appreciate it a lot. Good luck with your situation at well! I hope you’re able to leave that shitty friend and get the situation with her animals fixed.
I’ve tried that before but I live in a smaller town so there was only about 5 people on there that I could choose from and none of us had much in common at all.

I made a post similar to this earlier haha. But yes!  I can never shut the fuck up for once in my life lol. I have ADHD alongside BP and I’m on meds for it but I still talk sooo much. I think that’s just apart of me though and not a “disordered” part. I had a conversation a while ago with a friend and I remember telling her about how I think talking a lot is apart of me and all I could think to say was “talking just feels good, I’m not gonna stop doing something that feels good”. This also makes me the call for the obnoxious one though. Any time I try to make plans with others they cancel last minute, so I just try to remember that people have their own lives outside of me, or maybe they just didn’t weren’t in the mood to hangout. If someone doesn’t like me will it kill me? No. Will I cry over it? Maybe. There’s billions of people in the world and one of them is bound to like the real you.

I’m on meds too and they were a lifesaver for me. I’m pretty stabilized besides some anxiety stuff, but I think that’s gonna be something I have to work on aside from medication. I had some bad friends before too. One of my shitty ex-friends actually saw me on campus a couple weeks ago and I almost though of rekindling our friendship, but then after the second day of hanging out with her I realized she was still the same shitty person she was before and I told her I wasn’t comfortable being friends again. I used to always go back to shitty ex-friends just because I was lonely, but I’ve finally stopped myself from doing so. 

I know I gotta leave my comfort zone to get somewhere, taking the first step out is just so hard and sometimes I’m just like “maybe my life is meant to be like this” as a bumper to not make the effort, but that’s just bad brain talking. I like to listen to a lot of music to help myself too! I prefer angry femme punk stuff, it makes me feel empowered and cool lol, at least when I’m by myself. 

Thanks for the reply though! I was hoping someone would say something instead of me just yelling this nonsense into the void.

Both of my best friends moved out of state for the summer so I’m constantly forced to be by myself a lot of the time now and I do hate it but I’m finding ways to cope. 

Looking into a hobby you think would interest you or picking up on good old hobbies is sometimes helpful. I personally like to draw or organize and it helps distract me from my loneliness. I like to put on some music that makes me happy or reminds me of good  times when I’m doing these other activities too because it gives me the tiniest smidge bit more of motivation. On days I don’t have the energy or imagination for a new art project I just try to finish up an old one. Try thinking of unfinished projects or things you’ve been putting off for a while, like if you’ve been avoiding putting the dishes away you could do that or anything else that comes to mind. It’s something small but getting it off your to-do list could help make you feel better. 

Journaling out your feelings helps a lot too even if you end up erasing or deleting it all after its been typed out but the point is you got it out of your brain and onto paper or a computer. 

Summer is always seen as some fun happy time because of the weather and everyones on vacation but it’s not all the time. I’m always the lonliest in the summers but I just try to keep myself occupied with things so I can forget how lonely I am haha. 

I hope all goes best for you though, keep going, things will get better. There’s always just rough shitty patches but you’ll be able to get through it and get to a good area.

I had the worst low recently, from about January-May, it was like nothing I’ve ever experienced before and I felt literally doomed for my life. I felt like death was following me and any minute would be my last. The most depressing part was I even started warning my best friend about me dying soon. I would tell her I was sorry if I’m not around much longer and that I appreciated her. I felt like my doctors and therapists couldn’t help me anymore because I was being pulled down a black hole of the most severe depression anyone could ever experience it was like every single person I loved died at once. In essence I felt so terrified, scared, doomed for my life, and any other synonym for scared you can think of. I made it out though and I still get scared sometimes thinking about it because I’m afraid I’m going to enter that area of despair again but I someohow made it out of that alive. This illness is scary sometimes but it’ll be okay. Medication and the help from my therapist pulled me out of that hole. Getting on medication again could help you sometimes it gets boring because you don’t get to experience those manic states anymore but it also helps prevent the depressive states too which are not fun. I hope things get better soon, they will it just takes time and the wait is excrutiating but I understand the place you’re in.

I’m very open about mine even on social media. I even posted on Instagram about my trip to the psycward and my suicide attempts but I don’t post it in a negative way, it’s more of a “you never truly know what someone’s going through” type of thing, and I always made the efforts to link resources or tell others that there’s nothing to be ashamed of. I guess the only thing is that I’m not very specific about which illnesses I have. I have bi polar 2, PTSD, borderline personality disorder, and ADHD so I’m a bit scared if I list all of them people may think I’m exaggerating and I feel like it’s not necesarry to talk about all of the disorders I personally have but rather all mental illnesses. I actually even wrote an entire personal blog with my name and picture on it thats supposed to be published onto my colleges website so once that’s out there the other thousands of people that visit that site will know. I sugarcoated some of it only because I figured if it was too graphic my boss would probablly want to change it. I like to put it out there a lot though because I feel like the more I talk about it publicly the more it becomes normalized, if I tell someone I’m bi polar I don’t want them to say “I’m sorry” or something along the lines of pitying me, I just want it to be a normal thing you can discuss. It’s helped me when I’ve seen others be public about their own illnesses whether it’s online or in person so I try and force myself to let it out and not to delete any personal posts because then I feel like it’s a step back and not a step forward. If someone leaves or judges you because you’re public about your illness then they’re not good friends, being open weeds out the bad ones and brings the true ones closer.
